visual_action: The video starts with the Taco Bell logo. A text overlay appears reading, "Taco Bell won't serve certain items amid cyclosporaisis outbreak." Another text overlay is added: "Taco Bell doing more to stop the diarrhea outbreak than Trump admin." The video then transitions into a fast-paced montage of various Taco Bell food items, including tacos, nachos, quesadillas, and drinks. One shot is overlaid with a flame effect. In a later shot of Cinnabon Delights and a Mountain Dew Baja Blast, a small circular cutout of Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s face appears in the bottom right corner.
